purpose: Original bundled Rilova environmental illustrations, decorative only. No runtime generation or network service.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original production landscape illustration for the Rilova iOS habit and focus app, wide 3:2 landscape artwork without any interface.
Primary request: create a visually rich, premium, sculptural coastal world with glowing turquoise water flowing in broad organic ribbon-like curves between elegant softly textured terraces. A pearl-cream sun, coral/apricot sky light, deep petrol-teal foreground and distant blue-violet hills. Warm light meets cool water. The lower right contains a small clean rounded stone terrace where an existing app character can later be overlaid; do not draw a character. The left and upper-middle have calm open atmosphere to allow a separate UI composition. Layered depth, beautifully controlled luminous gradients, fine tactile editorial grain, soft ambient occlusion, sophisticated original art direction. Soft-touch ceramic and sculpted paper material, not photorealistic and not a flat vector icon. A few expressive broad-leaf plants near the bottom corners; strong silhouette and gentle natural forms. Composed as one cohesive collectible illustration, inviting and vibrant without visual clutter.
Color palette: teal and aqua anchor, with luminous pearl, apricot and a restrained violet counterpoint.
Constraints: full bleed to all edges, landscape 1536 by 1024 preferred. No text, logos, lettering, numbers, UI, cards, borders, device frame, watermark, humans or animals. This must be usable as an illustrated environment in an app, not a screenshot or a design board.

Create the dark-appearance production variant of this exact Rilova coastal environment. Preserve the composition, architecture, terraces, plants, shorelines, water curves, viewpoint and empty stone character platform precisely. Change illumination and palette to a luminous twilight / moonlit sanctuary: deep midnight indigo sky with a subtle violet-to-petrol glow, a soft pearl moon where the sun was, richly luminous turquoise and teal water, a few warm amber architectural lights, pearl teal reflected highlights on the softly textured pale terraces. Sophisticated and beautiful, strong readable silhouette and tonal depth, calm but vivid, no flat black areas. Retain the fine tactile editorial illustration quality and all framing. No new objects, no characters, no text, no UI, no borders or watermark. Landscape, same dimensions and composition as the reference.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original production illustration for Rilova, a premium habit and focus iOS app, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: a beautifully crafted quiet focus sanctuary overlooking a luminous turquoise coastal inlet at blue hour. Softly sculpted pale stone terrace in the lower-right foreground with one clean round low platform reserved for an app character that will be overlaid later; do not draw the character. A graceful rounded architectural arch at the right edge, one warm amber lantern on a far step, expressive broad-leaf plants in the lower corners, layered indigo islands and a small pearl moon reflected in teal water. Water and terrace lines sweep in elegant wide ribbon curves toward the horizon. Sophisticated vibrant petrol teal, deep ultramarine, lavender twilight and warm apricot light. Premium editorial illustration with tactile fine grain, soft-touch sculpted ceramic/paper material, gentle volumetric light and subtle ambient occlusion. Detailed, immersive and luminous while composition stays uncluttered; avoid photorealistic camera styling. Center-left has open dark teal atmosphere for a separately drawn timer/interface; do not draw text or UI. Cohesive calming illustrated world with a memorable silhouette, polished production asset.
Constraints: full bleed, landscape 1536 by 1024 preferred; no letters, words, numbers, logos, watermark, phone frame, UI elements, cards, animals, people, desks or devices.

usage: Native text and metrics remain separate from artwork. Increased Contrast/Reduce Transparency provide solid alternatives; saved companion visibility is honored. No competitor assets or new character artwork.
